execute_command("python - <<'PY'
seqid='seq_short_500bp'
fname='metapointfinder/notebooks/pad_to_10kb/output/test_padded_10kb.fasta'

    id=None
    seq=[]
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('>'):
            if id==seqid:
                print(len(''.join(seq)))
                raise SystemExit
            id=line[1:].strip().split()[0]
            seq=[]
        else:
            seq.append(line.strip())
    if id==seqid:
        print(len(''.join(seq)))
